violation_type.title: Make Provisions for Training (26 TAC §746.201(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained from the investigation,   this standard was reviewed and is determined that the operation did not provide opportunities for staff to complete appropriate training based on the requirements from the Minimum Standards.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained from the investigation,   this standard was reviewed and is determined that the operation did not provide opportunities for staff to complete appropriate training based on the requirements from the Minimum Standards.
Based on the information obtained from the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to provide proper training to the staff members at the operation.
The operation is lacking a system for ensuring professional development is accurately completed as detailed in subchapter D of the minimum standards.
